extracted.name: Easy Creamy Banana Pudding
extracted.description: This beloved dessert comes together perfectly with Eagle Brand Sweetened Condensed Milk.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) can EAGLE BRAND® Sweetened Condensed Milk
1 (4-serving size) package instant vanilla pudding mix
3 medium bananas, sliced and dipped in
instruction_lines: In large bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix; beat until well blended. Chill 5 minutes.
Fold in whipped cream. Spoon 1 cup pudding mixture into 2 1/2-quart glass serving bowl.

Top with one-third each of the vanilla wafers, bananas and remaining pudding. Repeat layering twice, ending with pudding mixture. Chill thoroughly. Garnish as desired. Store leftovers covered in refrigerator.
